name: Streaming Wyoming S Dao Statutes E75Ad65028
text: Wyoming’s DAO Statutes presents the following source proposition: In 2021, the state of Wyoming folded the cryptocurrency-based organizations into the state’s definition of limited liability company (LLC), a legislative move that almost immediately drew widespread attention and criticism, while prompting the introduction of mirrored legislation in other states. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Bitcoin and Ethereum are worth hundreds of billions of dollars not because people are using them but almost entirely because of speculation on their future value, which is the expectation that people will use them to build decentralized autonomous organizations. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
